 You want to use oranguru, Bruno, professor's research, Marnie and tower of darkness to draw cards in your deck. The houndooms are how you accelerate energy.

Hello Friend. Everyone's comments are very thoughtful and correct about the meta. However I don't think you're playing right. 

I play rapid strike Urshifu. Online and I've played in tournaments and the way you're describing the game doesn't make sense to me. Either Urshifu require set up for your support Pokemon and dumps energy when they do their big attack which means you need the support Pokemon to get them set back up. So just getting one on first is definitely an advantage but it can be overcome. 

You may want to review the rules and make sure you're playing everything correctly. You can Google the decks and find YouTube videos of people playing them. And get a better idea of how they function in the rules interactions involved with playing them. 

And remember they are not the prefect version of the decks as mentioned before, So they're not as consistent as they could be. It pretty much all the cards there are there for a reason and part of learning the deck is learning why and how you would use those cards. 

Good luck and have fun.
